name: Gnoll Prophet

book: Kobold Quest From Ashes to Empire

body:
GNOLL PROPHET
CR 7

XP 3,200
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)
Init +7, Senses Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 mage armor)
hp 69 (7d6 +35)
Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +7
Immunities Charm, fear effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee flail +10 (1d8 +4)
Spells Prepared (CL 7th)

4th–wall of fire
3rd–fireball, haste
2nd–blur, glitterdust, scorching ray
1st–burning hands, obscuring mist, shocking grasp
0th–dancing lights, flare, message open/close

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con 18, Int 20, Wis 14, Cha 13
Base Atk +5; CMB +6, CMD 18
Feats Improved Initiative, toughness

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fanaticism (Ex)

The gnoll prophet is immune to all charm and fear effects. He has special bonuses to hit and bonus damage with a flail. Both are noted above.
